summary: Advance your career with expert LMS Administration training. Master SCORM, xAPI, system integration, and learning analytics. Enroll today for expert-led skills.
lede: LMS administration training helps technical and functional professionals manage learning platforms, users, content, and system data. It covers configuring user roles and integrations, validating digital learning content, automating workflows, mapping data flows, and building reports on learner progress and system performance through practical administration tasks.
audienceIntro: This program is tailored for technical and functional professionals responsible for the health and performance of enterprise-scale learning environments.
audience: L&D Operations Managers focused on administrative process
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 12 months of experience working within a Learning Management System in an administrative or support capacity. A basic understanding of e-learning content formats (SCORM) and general HR business processes is required. No prior programming or SQL knowledge is necessary, though familiarity with Excel for data manipulation is highly recommended.
